nl: 费用报销：查询有报销单号、报销人；表格展示报销单号、报销人、金额、状态、提交时间；新增和编辑使用不同的弹窗——新增填报销人、金额，编辑在此基础上还能修改状态；支持新增、编辑、删除；「金额」列仅在有权限时可见，权限码 expense:amount:view；新增、编辑、删除按钮需要权限码 expense:add、expense:edit、expense:remove；查询表单分 2 列。
nlEn: Expense claims: query by claim no. and applicant; the table shows claim no., applicant, amount, status, and submit time; add and edit use different dialogs — on add fill in applicant and amount, and on edit you can additionally change the status; supports add, edit, and delete; the "amount" column is visible only with permission, code expense:amount:view; the add, edit, and delete buttons require permission codes expense:add, expense:edit, expense:remove; the query form is 2 columns.
notes: 四维覆盖：fieldSpan(querySpan) + dialogs + permissions + extPoints(列级 permissionValue 门控)。schema 模式顶层 permissions 仅进 summary 行，对渲染 inert。
